# Architecture decision record. adr-check validates this front matter and the section order. File name:
# ADR-NNNN-<slug>.md with the id's number and a lower-case kebab slug. Maximum 80 lines.
id: ADR-0000            # ADR-NNNN, never reused, never renumbered
title: "Decision title"
status: Proposed        # Proposed | Accepted | Superseded (the founder flips Proposed to Accepted)
date: YYYY-MM-DD
decision_refs: []       # external decision ids this ADR answers or replaces, for example [D-126]
supersedes: []          # ADR ids this replaces; each must exist and be marked Superseded
---
# ADR-0000: Decision title

## Context

What forces the decision, with the master plan section or machine fact each claim rests on.

## Decision

What is decided. Every normative sentence (MUST, SHOULD, MAY) cites a master plan section, a machine fact
or another ADR; an uncited claim is not stated as a decision.

## Consequences

What follows: gates, files, work orders and open issues.

## Alternatives

What was considered and why it was not chosen.
